title: Get approval for works to a State heritage item
what: Do work that damages a heritage place only in accordance with a work approval, heritage agreement or other listed exception.

sources.title: Heritage Act 2011 (NT)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person engages in conduct that results in damage to a heritage place or object.

sources.title: Heritage Act 2011 (NT)
sources.quote: In addition, subsections (1) and (2) do not apply if the person: (a) engages in conduct in accordance with: (i) a heritage agreement; or (ii) a work approval;

reach.condition: if it owns or works on an item on the State Heritage Register or under an interim heritage order
